caption:
🥇 Summer Olympic gold, country by country — 1896 → 2024.

The United States has 1,110 golds. Second place has 395 — and it's a country that no longer exists. Watch the Soviet Union arrive in 1952, climb to second in forty years, then vanish in 1992; its successors start again from zero. Meanwhile China arrives late and reaches 303 🏟️

📊 Data: Wikipedia, from IOC and Olympedia records (CC BY-SA). The USSR, Unified Team, Russia, East and West Germany are counted separately, as the IOC does.
